items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: Yeah, they had Hugh, Wilson, and Landry on trumpet.

ctx.x: Yeah, I remember when Landry died, I went to... Landry died after Wilson. Yeah, I remember during Mardi Gras time.

Yeah, they had Hugh, Wilson, and Landry on trumpet. On trumpet, yeah. That's the time it was the Hugh Riker band. That's when they buried... Over the river they had... Henderson. Henderson. There had them three bands out there. That's there. Tuxedo, Ricker, and the Excelsior. Who was Henderson?
Was he a musician? No, he was Undertaker man.
